notes.紫微: Broad and steady money paths, often with help or family backing. You value face, so you earn and spend generously; sort out income and outlay gradually and don't stretch credit too far.
notes.天机: You earn with your mind and planning, with bigger swings in income. Going deep on one skill and keeping an even pace feels safer than chasing opportunities.
notes.太阳: Money comes honestly and you spend openly, generous in both directions. Keep a floor when spending on friends and family; building steadily on your own is most solid.
notes.武曲: A natural affinity with money and a talent for managing it, like a mine that reveals its weight only with patient working. Finance, treasury, and real industry all fit; paths steady with age.
notes.天同: Money is not tight and occasional windfalls come; you spend casually. Culture, education, catering, and travel fit; save more when young and later years are lighter.
notes.廉贞: You like money and dare to spend it. Opportunity-based income appears but is hard to keep. At heart you are fairly steady and not very adventurous; spending on relationships is often worth more.
notes.天府: Like a small vault, cautious and good at saving, always able to put something by. Public service or finance in a large organization is steady; no need for outsized risks.
notes.太阴: Spending is measured and income is steady, with a taste for slowly building assets. Income is ample when you are in good form; leave margin when things drain you.
notes.贪狼: Many opportunities and much competition; money comes and goes quickly. Big swings early on, settling later; wanting less actually helps you keep more.
notes.巨门: You live by your words and a specialty, mostly self-reliant on a steady salary. Building assets slowly brings increasing solidity; avoid petty quarrels.
notes.天相: Able to manage money with no shortage of paths, mostly from stable professional services. Cautious by nature, you accumulate step by step.
notes.天梁: No shortage of money, often with elders' support and the odd windfall. Generosity is good; when lending, lend only what you can afford.
notes.七杀: Money must be earned gate by gate, with some swings. Often self-employed; competitive fields such as structured services, chains, and manufacturing suit you.
notes.破军: Money follows pioneering work, with big swings and fast movement. Technical startups and constant renewal fit well; where keeping is not a strength, let a steady partner help.
